scope: Local synthetic maintenance/water-supply evidence. Design only until separately scoped implementation, independent review and runtime gates. Never recipient/public media.

preserve: two evidence slots per immutable revision

dependencies.pinning: Candidates researched 2026-10-21; not installed or artifact-verified. Before provisioning recheck official advisories/support, exact platform/Python ABI, archive/wheel SHA-256, available publisher signatures and independent pinned signing-key provenance. A digest fetched alongside an unverified artifact is not publisher authentication. Record missing authentication, bundled codec/DLL versions and license notices; do not claim supply-chain/security certification. No silent version fallback or global install.

rules: Closed UTF-8 JSON; reject duplicate/nonfinite/unknown fields, depth>8/nodes>2048. Schema exact int1, positive generation, no bool. SHA256 lowercase ASCII 64-hex/C semantics; aware UTC. Observed created_at/scan/check/signed timestamps cannot be future-dated; detect clock reversal. valid_until intentionally future: created_at < valid_until <= created_at+604800 seconds. Expiry is not an observed event and cannot refresh a check/build time.

Canonical SHA-256 of manifest binds every policy/codec/helper/isolation/limits/signature input. Every signature_files member contains fixed allowlisted official basename, SHA-256, signed database version/build time and verification receipt. At most 16 members; no path, URL, signature name or free-form metadata in ORM/client output.

Actual runnable files, DLLs, interpreter and official signature database set must match verified provenance. Version strings alone are insufficient. Tool/signature generations are exclusively created, canonical, ownership/ACL checked, immutable/read-only to application/helpers; never registry/PATH/default-directory discovery.

Private trusted current-manifest pointer names exactly one reviewed generation. Activation/revocation and every prepare/commit/download participate in mandatory cross-process manifest fence below BEFORE organization locks. No web activation/automatic upgrade. Missing pointer/receipt, changed provenance/ACL, stale check, unsupported/revoked generation closes access.

Refresh uses a separate workspace-owned updater allowed only official signature distribution endpoints and no project data. Never clamsubmit/sample upload or scanner network. Stage a fresh generation, verify official signatures and engine compatibility, atomically switch only the trusted pointer. Never overwrite active/open generation files; use checked immutable handles or equivalent TOCTOU protection.

Successful freshclam no-update checks may refresh a verified update-check receipt without fabricating a new database build time. Timestamp extension requires a real verified check, not file mtime. Validation expires at the earliest policy expiry, scan+24h, successful update-check+24h and signed daily database+72h. Database generation changes require new validation; old records remain immutable.
manifest.private_receipts: No receipt contains uploaded bytes, names, EXIF, image/source digests or arbitrary tool output. Executable/package/database artifact hashes are permissible provenance; evidence hashes stay in private encrypted/DB records.

fence.resource: Workspace-hash-derived fixed Windows Local named mutex with checked owner/DACL for trusted application/operator principals, excluding scanner/decoder capabilities. Equivalent OS cross-process fence requires separate proof; Python threading lock or checked lockfile alone insufficient.
fence.acquisition: Wait at most5s. Wrong owner/DACL, abandoned mutex, unknown marker, absent capability or acquire failure => unavailable/quarantine. Never automatically continue after abandonment; trusted operator must quiesce/reverify. Every application/command/updater process participates.
fence.ordering: Manifest fence -> organization -> actor -> report -> revision -> evidence -> validation -> audit. Never acquire fence while holding business DB locks. Updater performs network/staging outside fence, takes fence only for verified activation/revocation and never takes business locks.
fence.lifetime: Prepare holds fence through authorized snapshot+manifest capture then releases before native work; children use pinned immutable generations. Commit reacquires fence BEFORE DB locks, requires captured generation unchanged, holds through currentness checks/insert/audit and successful COMMIT. Download holds fence through scope/manifest/latest-attempt/integrity checks, audit COMMIT and complete bounded response preparation (delivery linearization); release afterwards. No native work/network under fence.
fence.race: Pointer switch before commit/download linearization denies stale-generation insertion/delivery; activation cannot switch within a held critical section. Switch after authorized delivery linearization cannot recall bytes. Unexpected pointer/receipt mutation despite fence is protocol violation and closes access. Artifact handles alone do not synchronize currentness.
fence.tests: Two-process tests prove activation waits during commit/download; prior switch rejects old snapshot; abandonment/spoofing/failure closes access; no lock inversion.

validation_model.name: PrivateEvidenceValidation
validation_model.kind: New append-only table; never promote/update PrivateEvidence.

fields.validated_by: PROTECT FK accounts.User; current original-access actor who initiated explicit run
fields.operation_id: UUID; caller persists exact request identity for retry
fields.request_hash: SHA-256 purpose+actor+evidence+original request hash+input digest+manifest hash
fields.manifest_hash: SHA-256 of exact canonical reviewed manifest
fields.signature_generation: SHA-256 of exact verified official database set
fields.input_sha256: Private digest of decrypted original bytes
fields.validated_at: Nullable UTC completion timestamp; required only VALIDATED_PRIVATE
fields.expires_at: Nullable UTC expiry; required only VALIDATED_PRIVATE
fields.provenance_ciphertext: Encrypted closed-schema copy of exact manifest, fixed step outcomes and times; bounded plaintext <=64 KiB; no raw tool output
fields.derivative_ciphertext: Nullable encrypted typed envelope containing normalized PNG bytes and identity binding; present iff VALIDATED_PRIVATE
fields.derivative_sha256: Nullable lowercase SHA-256, present iff VALIDATED_PRIVATE
fields.derivative_size: Nullable exact integer 1..5242880, present iff VALIDATED_PRIVATE
fields.width: Nullable exact integer 1..6000, present iff VALIDATED_PRIVATE
fields.height: Nullable exact integer 1..6000, present iff VALIDATED_PRIVATE
fields.key_id: Fixed established local-fernet-v1; no claim of independent key custody/rotation

constraints: Unique(validated_by,operation_id) across evidence and manifests; never global cross-account digest deduplication.
All relation organizations agree and evidence/actor exist; use organization INSERT guard. FK targets PROTECT. Live permission remains a service check.
Before UPDATE or DELETE always reject using append-only guard. No state-transition UPDATE or cascade deletion.

CHECK explicit non-null validated fields iff VALIDATED_PRIVATE/code VALIDATION_COMPLETE, derivative encrypted bytes nonempty, hashes valid, pixel product <=24000000, validated_at <= created_at < expires_at, expires_at <= validated_at+24h. SQL NULL/UNKNOWN cannot satisfy an incomplete validated branch; explicit IS NOT NULL checks required.

Nonvalidated rows have all derivative fields and validated_at/expires_at NULL. provenance_ciphertext and input/request/manifest hashes required for every committed attempt; failure before trustworthy manifest/decrypt yields no fabricated record, only fixed unavailable result.

Index evidence+created_at+id for deterministic latest attempt; index organization+evidence. No uniqueness on evidence+manifest, because unavailable attempts and expired checks can be retried with a new operation UUID.

never_safe: stored VALIDATED_PRIVATE without current manifest/scope/integrity/audit checks

interfaces.prepare_validation: prepare_validation(user,evidence_id,operation_id,*,manifest) -> ValidationSnapshot. Manifest fence then short org-first transaction; current original authorization and exact authority_snapshot mapping below; decrypt/validate envelope/bytes/hash/size. Same authorized request returns immutable prior attempt; conflict409. Detached bounded bytes contain no key/DB credentials. Release fence/DB locks before native work.
interfaces.run_validation: run_validation(snapshot, *, manifest, isolated_runner) -> ValidationResult. No ORM/network; manifest/isolator checks first, scan original -> bounded decode/normalize -> structurally validate output -> scan derivative. Unknown/exception fixed quarantine result. Every step and manifest must agree; never accept client verdict.
interfaces.commit_validation: commit_validation(user,snapshot,result,*,manifest) -> private status. Reacquire manifest fence BEFORE business locks; require unchanged captured generation; org-first transaction rechecks live source authorization and exact authority_snapshot fields, evidence hash, freshness, result schema and verified scratch cleanup. Encrypt/insert/audit atomically, hold fence through COMMIT. Supported revoke/regrant/context change invalidates old snapshot despite renewed access; new operation required. Failed authorization/audit => no insert/delivery.
interfaces.command: validate_private_evidence --actor <UUID> --evidence <UUID> --operation <UUID> [--prepare|--execute]. --prepare default verifies dependencies/guards without decrypt/decode/scan/write; explicit --execute only checked local synthetic runtime. Single explicit evidence ID and actor; no implicit bulk scan or global object enumeration. Persist operation ID for identical retry; new operation permits revalidation. Output fixed status/codes and aggregate counts only, no object/source digest/name/byte/tool output. No autonomous daemon or HTTP validation trigger in first slice.
interfaces.retrieval: private_evidence_download(user, evidence_id) -> immutable prepared PNG response. Use current original-source authorization, current manifest and latest matching valid attempt selected deterministically; never fall back to an earlier success after a later current-generation failure. Validate/decrypt complete envelope and hash/size/dimensions before required audit in same authorized transaction; then return bounded already-prepared bytes. No scanner/decoder spawned by GET.
interfaces.status: New private validation status API as described in api section; baseline quarantine/upload DTO remains frozen.

authority_snapshot.actual_sources: scopes.access lock_identity/source_allowed/live_memberships; User.permission_version; accounts.services supported grant/account/password mutations; Unit.scope_epoch. No separate membership_epoch/session_version field exists.
fields: exact active actor+origin-unit+role UnitMembership IDs and organization/user/unit/role/active/valid_until values
authority_snapshot.rules: Require live author-submitter/origin-reviewer membership and active unit at prepare+commit. Re-read exact values/IDs under org lock; independently evaluate current expiry and require equality. Supported grant/account/password changes increment permission_version; topology changes increment scope_epoch, preventing supported revoke/regrant reuse. Arbitrary owner SQL that restores identical rows without versions is outside guarantee. Operator command has no browser session; HTTP uses real current Django session auth whose hash includes permission_version. Channel/policy authority never grants original access.

mandatory: Decoder and scanner run as separate owned children with no inherited DB/key/session/secret/environment credentials, no shell/desktop/Image.show/Ghostscript/delegates, no arbitrary filename argument and only explicit absolute reviewed executable/library paths.

OS-enforced network denial and filesystem boundary: read-only reviewed runtime/signature generation plus explicit minimal OS loader/DLL/registry-read baseline, and exclusive private per-run scratch as the only writable area. Bind actual allowlist/DACL/token capabilities in isolation_profile_sha256; no general user-profile/workspace/root read access. Windows AppContainer/LPAC or reviewed equivalent needs actual negative probes; job/restricted token alone is not filesystem/network/disk-quota proof. Include every inherently writable sandbox profile/AppData/temp path in the same total64MiB quota and private containment, or deny/redirect it before execution. An unaccounted writable profile area or unsupported confinement => ISOLATION_UNAVAILABLE. Do not create global firewall/service/profile/config changes under this contract.

Create child suspended/guarded, assign enforcing job/resource sandbox before any input or execution; job kill-on-close and no breakaway/descendants, process count one, memory/CPU/wall limits. CREATE_NO_WINDOW on Windows. Kill only verified owned children on timeout; cap/drain stdout/stderr without deadlock; no unbounded communicate accumulation.

Exclusive canonical UUID scratch under private workspace root; owner sentinel and restrictive DACL BEFORE any data. Reject reparse/symlink/junction/hardlink/redirected parents/targets or adoption. Enforce64MiB total scratch quota/write budget and private filesystem confinement BEFORE transfer; after-write directory monitors/engine limits alone are not hard quota proof. Missing enforcement => quarantine. Each scanner pass may spool its bounded <=5MiB original OR derivative stdin plaintext plus bounded engine extraction within this scratch; stdin is NOT no-disk. No decoder/application-created original file, shared OS temp, persistent filename or scanner logs. Apply spool_lifecycle below.

Parent alone holds encryption keys and ORM connections. Do not fork an initialized ORM/key-holding parent into helper; launch fresh interpreter with isolated import path. IPC uses 4-byte length-prefixed closed JSON header <=4096 bytes followed by exact bounded binary bytes, no trailing data. Validate header types/length before allocation, digest/identity on return, process exit, output cap, timeout and EOF.

spool_lifecycle.upstream: ClamAV1.4.6 scanstdin creates an engine-TMPDIR file, writes all stdin BEFORE scanning, then attempts unlink. Errors/termination/unlink failure can leave plaintext; upstream cleanup alone insufficient.
spool_lifecycle.preconditions: Before decrypt/transfer, verify owner/DACL/quota/filesystem sandbox; route --tempdir and TMP/TEMP to exact exclusive empty per-pass scratch; deny every other writable path. Parent sends exact <=5242880 bytes then EOF. Scanner limits do not bound its pre-scan spool; parent transfer+OS quota do. Current-user/AppContainer identity without proven restrictive DACL insufficient.
spool_lifecycle.sequence: Original scan -> verified child exit and scratch cleanup -> decoder/normalizer -> derivative scan in new checked scratch -> verified exit and cleanup -> commit. No decode after failed original scan/cleanup; no validated record until both pass cleanup verifications.
spool_lifecycle.cleanup: Only after verified child exit: inspect without following links, recheck owner/DACL/canonical containment and file identity. Allow only exclusively owned regular single-link files within flat per-pass directory and aggregate quota; remove each verified file individually; verify empty and remove only that owned empty directory. No recursive delete/adoption/overwrite. Leftover hierarchy/link/changed identity/ACL/undeletable file/unknown child => SCRATCH_CLEANUP_REQUIRED, preserve confined private artifacts, block all further execution until separately reviewed operator resolution. Intermediate engine directories may normally disappear; any remaining hierarchy is not swept.
spool_lifecycle.confidentiality: Explicit transient plaintext original/derivative spool allowance within enforced private sandbox. File removal is not secure erasure or protection from filesystem journals/pagefile/crash dumps/host operator; review host volume/custody before activation. Local synthetic scope only. Persistent encrypted originals/history remain retained.
spool_lifecycle.tests: Pinned Windows build: benign original+derivative scans leave empty scratch; stdin/EOF/quota enforced before/during writes; kill-during-spool, write/read/unlink failure, remaining hierarchy, ambient temp fallback, link/owner/DACL change => no validated success/outside write; no raw bytes/path/tool text in reports.

decoder.mode_rule: Explicitly tested bounded grayscale/palette expansion to RGB or RGBA only; preserve transparency pixels without preserving palette/metadata chunks. CMYK, LAB, floating/high-bit-depth and unknown modes reject until separately reviewed. Cap total JPEG APP/comment and PNG ancillary metadata before native parsing; malformed metadata rejects.
pipeline: Independent signature/MIME/preflight and strict full container framing before native decode; reject trailing payload and malformed JPEG marker/PNG chunk framing rather than trusting header-only helper. Check PNG CRC/order and forbid APNG control/data chunks; reject JPEG MPO/multiframe metadata.

Pillow Image.open(BytesIO, formats=['JPEG','PNG']) only; no third-party plugins. Set Image.MAX_IMAGE_PIXELS=24000000 and treat DecompressionBombWarning as error; check strict dimensions/product and n_frames==1 before load. LOAD_TRUNCATED_IMAGES remains false. Set PNG text decompression totals/chunk caps <=65536 before open; over-limit metadata rejects, never silently enables a bypass.

Run verify(), close, reopen with same formats, recheck dimensions/frames/type then load() fully. verify() alone does not decode. Warnings/malformed/unsupported metadata or unexpected parser behavior fail closed inside resource sandbox.

Apply bounded ImageOps.exif_transpose for validated orientation, then create a fresh RGB/RGBA image from pixels; never forward image.info/EXIF/XMP/IPTC/ICC/comments/pnginfo. No resizing, OCR, privacy redaction or sensitive-content claims. Reject unsupported color interpretation rather than guessing; test CMYK conversion explicitly before supporting.

Encode fresh deterministic PNG with empty metadata into a capped output sink; stop before >5242880 bytes. Parent verifies exact signature, IHDR RGB/RGBA8 noninterlaced dimensions, CRCs, contiguous IDAT and final IEND, allowing only IHDR/IDAT/IEND and no trailing bytes. Native helper fully reloads output inside same sandbox to confirm frame/pixel dimensions. Then independent scanner pass over exact derivative bytes.
decoder.limitation: Normalization removes file metadata, not visible sensitive text/coordinates or pixel steganography. Private original-source scope always required. Derivative is explicitly a normalized private copy, not original-byte evidence.

scanner.choice: One-shot official clamscan on bounded stdin '-' per original/derivative; pinned1.4.6 spools plaintext stdin to confined private scratch. No daemon/service/socket or no-disk claim.
invocation_rules: Absolute owned executable; shell=False; explicit immutable database directory with --database, --official-db-only=yes, --disable-cache, --alert-exceeds-max=yes, --alert-encrypted=yes, --max-filesize=5242880, --max-scansize=33554432, --max-files=32, --max-recursion=4, --max-scantime=60000, --follow-file-symlinks=0, --follow-dir-symlinks=0 and explicit owned --tempdir. Preserve normal engine format scanning; no --remove/--move/--copy/--leave-temps/--gen-json/--log/--debug/--file-list/recursive scanning.

Exact reviewed version supports every requested flag; unknown/ignored/unsupported options quarantine. Sanitized minimal environment disables proxy/PATH/library overrides and user/global config discovery; no external daemon adoption. --tempdir plus TMP/TEMP name checked per-pass sandbox; no ambient temp fallback. Engine flags never replace OS quota, parent stdin bound or verified cleanup.

Return code0 plus expected single stdin clean result, valid loaded official signatures, no warning/error/skip/limit markers, bounded well-formed protocol and enforced complete process exit required on BOTH passes. Code1 => SCAN_NOT_CLEAN; code2/nonzero/unknown/malformed/timeout=>SCANNER_UNAVAILABLE or RESOURCE_LIMIT; never parse arbitrary signature labels into logs/client fields.

Parent captures bounded scanner messages privately in memory only and immediately discards them after mapping to fixed code. Any unknown diagnostic, output truncation, incomplete input transfer or skipped/partial scan quarantines. Integration tests must show engine limit/time-limit outcomes cannot become clean on the pinned build.
scanner.alternative_protocol: clamd INSTREAM is deliberately deferred: unauthenticated TCP, external config and generation/ownership races require a separate reviewed owned-service design. If later approved use exact NUL-framed commands, unsigned big-endian chunk lengths <=65536, zero terminator, total bound, StreamMaxLength, timeout, response cap and exactly one complete result; never SCAN path commands/unowned daemon.

Existing GET evidence/{evidence_id}/ exact baseline quarantine DTO

new_status.rules: Current original-source actor only; audit required; no records/ids/hash/tool/version/name/size/EXIF/provenance. State reflects effective latest attempt/current readiness; stale success becomes QUARANTINED/VALIDATION_STALE, can_download false. No attempt => QUARANTINED/DECODER_REQUIRED (compatibility status code only). Missing/inaccessible uniform404. No collection/list/count endpoint.

download.success: 200 exact normalized PNG bytes, Content-Type:image/png, Content-Disposition:attachment; filename="evidence.png", Cache-Control:no-store, X-Content-Type-Options:nosniff, no ETag/Last-Modified/Range/conditional-cache or content-derived filename. Deny HEAD/OPTIONS alternate download/body bypass through explicit supported methods.
download.denial: Missing, inaccessible, no valid current attempt, revoked scope, stale manifest or failed integrity all fixed404 NOT_FOUND with no existence/state distinction. Audit/storage unavailability fixed503 before bytes; never partial output. All responses no-store.
download.linearization: Current authorization/manifest/latest validation and audit are checked atomically under org-first lock before response body construction. Revocation committed before that point blocks retrieval; bytes already delivered cannot be recalled. No cross-request plaintext cache.

api.auth: Real session authentication and normal CSRF for any later state-changing HTTP API. No bearer recipient integration/mobile evidence endpoints, redirects/public URLs or raw originals.

ui.scope: Minimal website author/current-origin-reviewer private original view only; new bounded task, no mobile contract change.
requirements: Accept only JPEG/PNG, show 5MiB/two-per-revision limits and normalized-private-copy label; client checks supplemental to server guards.

Upload operation UUID and exact immutable file/body survive uncertain retry; do not generate new UUID/resubmit on changed source revision. Show text receipt independently from evidence status; clear file buffers/object URLs on completion, source/account/context change and signout.

Fetch status only for evidence IDs received within currently authorized private source context; no recipient probing/presence indicator/count. Quarantine/failure shows fixed private message, never tool stderr/matched names/EXIF.

Download only explicit user click when current status permits; authenticated request prepares bounded Blob then fixed filename download; recheck backend denial and clear object URL/Blob after use. No inline image/thumbnail/browser decode, persisted localStorage/IndexedDB/service-worker evidence cache, auto-download or public media link.
Validation execution initially explicit operator command. UI must say pending/unavailable until completed; no simulated progress or assertion that scanner is installed/clean.

transaction_order: Cross-process manifest fence BEFORE organization -> actor -> report -> revision -> evidence -> validation -> audit. Never acquire fence after business locks; updater switches pointer under same fence without DB locks.

No DB locks held during decoder/scanner/update network or untrusted stream read. prepare releases; commit rechecks. Short retrieval preloads bounded ciphertext/bytes before success audit and response; audit failure aborts.

migrations.proposal: One additive operations migration after actual current leaves, name allocated by serialized migration writer. New table/indexes/guards only. Do not edit 0006 or existing immutable evidence rows/functions.
checks: Model state and SQL drift; guards enforce append-only/org/link/state/null/hash/time/size/pixel invariants.
Real disposable PostgreSQL forward preserves every old table row/hash/constraint; empty reverse/reapply succeeds; first reverse operation refuses populated new table before DROP.
Review exact new file/hash and plan after current full regression; fresh verified owned backup then separate exact user retained-migration approval. Earlier 0006/audit0002 approvals do not cover it.
Pending unapproved migration continues to stop retained startup; no fake applied ledger, --fake or bypass. No destructive rollback or purge.

planned_verification: Pure policy/IPC/manifest/date/type/path/timeout/resource/command-building tests with hostile and unknown results; scanner is never mocked as runtime acceptance.

Real maintained decoder valid JPEG/PNG, corrupt/truncated/boundary dimensions/pixel bombs/APNG/MPO/trailing payload/CMYK/EXIF-XMP-ICC-text canaries; normalized output exact allowed chunks and full decode; no metadata/secret/raw logs.

Real pinned official scanner benign image and harmless official test signature in isolated scratch, stale/missing/tampered database, EICAR/nonclean mapping, every limit/timeout/error/unknown output, original and derivative pass; no real malware/data upload.

OS negative probes prove no network/DB/key/outside-file access, child kill/no-breakaway, output/memory/CPU/scratch limits and reparse/ownership/TOCTOU rejection. Failure keeps quarantine; generic subprocess timeout alone insufficient.

Actual PostgreSQL/API real session/CSRF upload->validate->status->download, exact replay/conflict, same-manifest later failure, manifest refresh/revalidation, expired/provenance tamper/decrypt/audit rollback, authority revoke during processing and before download, cross-org/author/reviewer/admin/recipient denials, no evidence counts/search/map/feeds/integration/mobile leaks.

Current full owned backend + genuine HTTP/browser negative/privacy assertions, UI retry/context reset, migration preservation and separately guarded retained apply. No release/model/clean-machine claim from pure fixtures.

Actual cross-process manifest activation/revocation races, observed-vs-future-expiry timestamp boundaries, concrete authority_snapshot field mapping and pinned Windows scanner original-spool/kill/quota/unlink cleanup evidence; mocks/engine flags alone insufficient.
retention: No category windows/holds/purge invented. Preserve original quarantine, all validation attempts, encrypted derivatives, audit/provenance and required keys/backups under existing RETAIN_ALL. Scratch compensation covers only exclusive ephemeral validation files; persistent evidence removal needs separately approved category/hold policy.
human_gates: Independent security and QA inspect actual source, tools/provenance, isolation and executed evidence before enabling downloads.
Explicit exact retained migration approval after green disposable evidence/fresh backup.
Human operational/privacy/custodian policy and final M2/M3/M4/M5 acceptance remain separate. This contract grants no disclosure authority.
